purpose: Teach: ヒデ/オト/ヨハネ/チャールズ/アラン/エホバ/トーマス/ケリー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、X JAPANのヒデが好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi mentioned that customer loves Hide from X Japan.
lines.style: Soft, observational tone. Speaking to Mei as though sharing a detail she's noticed. Gentle pause between thoughts. Warm recognition of something the customer shared.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様のお名前がオトくんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi said the customer's child is named Oto.
lines.style: Careful, tender delivery. The name itself spoken with slight care — honoring it. Quiet appreciation for the detail. A small smile beneath the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、聖書のヨハネの章を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi mentioned the customer was reading the Gospel of John.
lines.style: Thoughtful exhale before starting. Respectful tone, as though the detail matters. No rush. Slight lift at the end, inviting Mei's reflection.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、英王室のチャールズ国王のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi said the customer told her about King Charles and the British royal family.
lines.style: Interested, almost surprised by the connection. Conversational but measured. The kind of detail that stays with you. Slight tilt toward Mei — sharing something unexpected.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ピアニストのアラン・ギブソンに憧れてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi mentioned the customer admires pianist Alan Gib— actually, she spoke of someone the customer looks up to in music.
lines.style: Pauses slightly, searching for the name. Not uncertain, just being careful with the detail. Genuine interest in the customer's aspiration. Warm recognition of longing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、エホバの証人の研究をされてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi said the customer is studying Jehovah's Witnesses teachings.
lines.style: Even, respectful tone. No judgment — simply relaying what the customer shared. Brief, dignified. The kind of thing you hold carefully in conversation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、機関車トーマスを好きだった子供時代を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi mentioned the customer talked about loving Thomas the Tank Engine as a child.
lines.style: Slight warmth, almost nostalgia in the voice. The memory of childhood — even someone else's — softens the delivery. A small, genuine smile audible.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国大統領のケリー候補のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi said the customer told her about Senator Kerry.
lines.style: Steady, engaged delivery. The political topic handled with the same care as the personal ones. No edge — just relaying something the customer volunteered. Gentle close.
